text:
Customer: we just moved to Pune, need a child specialist who is covered
Agent: There are four in-network paediatricians within 3 km of Baner.
Customer: lovely, please email them to me
Agent: Done.

Customer: it's been six weeks since my daughter's surgery and the claim is still not settled
Agent: It shows pending documents from the hospital.
Customer: the hospital says they sent everything. I'm fed up of going back and forth
Agent: I'll move you to the claims escalation desk.

Customer: can my thyroid medicine be delivered every 3 months automatically
Agent: Yes, I've set up auto-refill by mail for 90 days.
Customer: brilliant

Customer: you deducted the premium two times from my account this month
Agent: I can see two debits on the 1st.
Customer: I need that money back now, this is a serious mistake
Agent: I'm connecting you with the finance team to start the refund.

Customer: the name on my health card is spelt wrong
Agent: I've corrected it and a new card is on its way. The app shows the updated one already.
Customer: ok cool

Customer: the hospital won't admit my father for chemo until you approve it
Agent: The request was received this morning and is with a clinical reviewer.
Customer: he can't wait days for this, please do something
Agent: I'll get the urgent review team on the line.

Customer: just checking if the dental claim went through
Agent: Yes, it was paid on Friday.
Customer: nice, cheers

Customer: which eye hospitals near Salt Lake are cashless on my policy
Agent: Two network eye hospitals are within 4 km; I've sent the addresses by SMS.
Customer: got it
